test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**density**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Density** means **compactness**.
 
• Compactness in living society is determined by population, hence it is known as population density.
 
• The correct sentence would be, **It has a very low population density**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bulk** means **in large numbers**.

 
 
• Example, ***big companies have hundreds of customers to take care of, so they do production in bulk***.
 
 
 
• **Mass** means **a bundle or a stack**.
 
 
• Example, ***there is always a mass of dirty clothes in his room***.
 
 
 
• **Thickness** means **width**.
 
 
• Example, ***the legs of that table are 3 inches thick***.
